info.title: Private Cloud Control Plane API
info.description:
Accepts durable asynchronous lifecycle commands and exposes project-scoped read models.
A `202` response means intent and its operation record committed; it does not mean provider work completed.

get.summary: Read project quota limits and usage

delete.description: Normal deletion retains the provider resource; only an administrative purge destroys it.

post.summary: Accept a power or resize command

put.summary: Create or replace an image mapping

patch.summary: Update and disable a provider profile pending validation

get.summary: Read one operation with recovery metadata

post.summary: Accept an explicit guarded purge command

get.summary: List open or resolved manual-review items

replayed.description: True when the idempotency key returned the original operation.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A dependency required for this operation is unavailable

Forbidden.description: The actor lacks project or administrator permission

NotFound.description: The authorized resource does not exist

MutationAccepted.description: Durable intent and operation record committed

Conflict.description: Idempotency, concurrency, ownership, or state conflict

Unprocessable.description: Syntactically valid input violates a domain or safety invariant

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor; callers must not parse it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped mutation identity, bound to the actor, project, action, target, and canonical body hash.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional caller correlation UUID; the service creates one when absent.

Traceparent.name: traceparent
Traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context header. Invalid supplied values are rejected.

Tracestate.name: tracestate
Tracestate.description: Optional W3C vendor trace state, accepted only with a valid traceparent.
